offering_description.value: Rents, sells and services infusion pumps and related supplies for patients receiving drug infusions at home and in clinics. Serves home infusion providers, oncology practices and hospitals in the US and Canada, delivering pumps to patients and maintaining the pump fleet.

primary_products.value: infusion pumps; infusion supplies and disposables

primary_services.value: pump rental and fleet management; pump repair and maintenance; pump setup and patient support

customer_segment.value: B2B: home infusion providers, oncology practices, hospitals, ambulatory infusion centers

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: pump rental fees paid by providers for pumps in patients' care; product sales: sales of infusion pumps and disposable supplies; service fees: pump repair, maintenance and setup services; healthcare reimbursement: payments tied to infusion therapy billed to Medicare and private payers
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees; healthcare reimbursement

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and manages a fleet of infusion pumps deployed to patients; service provider: repairs, maintains and supports pumps, sold to infusion providers and clinics; distributor: buys pumps and supplies from device manufacturers and supplies them to providers

geography_served.value: North America: US nationwide and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: infusion pump rental and services, pump sales, and disposable infusion supplies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and rental contracts with infusion providers and clinics; other: pumps delivered to and picked up from patients' homes

regulatory_exposure.value: high: infusion pumps are FDA-regulated medical devices, Medicare and private payer reimbursement rules apply
